scams.title: Fake BISP Registration Link
scams.example_message: BISP se aap ke liye PKR 25,000 approve ho gaye hain. Registration complete karne ke liye is link par click karein: bit.ly/bisp-verify-2026
red_flags: Shortened/unofficial link (bit.ly) instead of gov.pk domain
Asks for CNIC or bank details via link, not official BISP office
scams.roman_urdu_advice: BISP kabhi bhi SMS ya WhatsApp link se registration nahi karta. Sirf apne nazdeeki BISP office ya official website (bisp.gov.pk) par jaa kar hi registration karein. Is link par click na karein.

scams.title: Jeeto Pakistan Lottery SMS
scams.example_message: Mubarak ho! Aap ne Jeeto Pakistan lucky draw mein PKR 500,000 jeete hain. Inaam claim karne ke liye 0300-XXXXXXX par call karein aur processing fee jama karwayein.
red_flags: User ne kabhi lottery mein participate nahi kiya
Inaam lene ke liye pehle 'processing fee' maangi ja rahi hai
Personal mobile number diya gaya hai, official helpline nahi
scams.roman_urdu_advice: Koi bhi asli lottery ya prize aap se pehle paisa nahi mangta. Aisi calls aur messages ko ignore karein aur kisi ko bhi apni bank details ya OTP na dein.

scams.title: Fake Bank / Wallet Account Block Alert
scams.example_message: JazzCash Alert: Aap ka account suspicious activity ki wajah se block ho gaya hai. Turant is number 0300-XXXXXXX par call karein warna account permanently band ho jayega.
red_flags: Official helpline ke bajaye personal number diya gaya
Bank/wallet apne customers ko kabhi call karke OTP ya PIN nahi maangte
scams.roman_urdu_advice: Apna OTP, PIN, ya CNIC number kisi ko bhi phone par na dein — chahe woh khud ko bank ya JazzCash/Easypaisa staff kahe. Shak ho to sirf official helpline number (jo card ya app par likha ho) par khud call karein.

scams.title: Fake Job Offer / Advance Fee Scam
scams.example_message: Mubarak ho, aap ka selection ho gaya hai Dubai company mein, salary 150,000. Visa aur processing fee PKR 15,000 is account mein bhej dein.
red_flags: Job offer bina interview ke di ja rahi hai
Advance fee mangi ja rahi hai visa/processing ke naam par
Company ka koi verifiable official email ya website nahi diya gaya
scams.roman_urdu_advice: Koi bhi legitimate company job dene se pehle paisa nahi mangti. Company ka naam Google par search karein aur official website se verify karein pehle koi payment karne se.
